name: Dawson Bruckman
office: Wiseburn Unified School District, Governing Board Member

items.text: Dawson Bruckman is a chief engineer and candidate for the Wiseburn Unified School District Governing Board. His campaign says he wants to make data-informed decisions to support staff and improve education.
